summary: Iteration 5 testing complete. All 48 backend tests passed (100%). Fixed critical bug in impersonation token scope. Frontend impersonation flow, gym admin creation, and PWA responsive design all working correctly.

fixed.issue: Impersonation token gym_id was not being used - get_current_admin() was returning original admin data instead of impersonated gym_id
fixed.fix: Modified get_current_admin() to override role and gym_id from JWT token when impersonating flag is set

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/admin/impersonate/{gym_id} - super admin can impersonate gym
Impersonation token correctly scoped to gym (members filtered by gym_id)
Impersonate non-existent gym returns 404
Gym admin cannot impersonate (returns 403)
POST /api/gyms with admin_email/admin_password auto-creates gym_admin
POST /api/gyms without admin credentials still works
Duplicate admin email during gym creation returns 400
GET /api/gyms returns gym_admin_email and gym_admin_name for each gym
FitZone admin login works (admin@fitzone.com / admin123)
PowerFit admin login works (admin@powerfit.com / powerfit123)
AdminGyms page shows 'Iniciar sesión como Admin' button on each gym card
AdminGyms create modal shows admin credentials fields (name, email, password)
AdminGyms card shows gym_admin_email when available
Impersonation banner appears at top with gym name when impersonating
Sidebar changes to gym_admin menu (no 'Gimnasios' item) when impersonating
Exit impersonation returns to super_admin view and navigates to /admin/gyms
PWA responsive - looks good on mobile viewport (375px width)
PWA bottom nav shows all 5 tabs properly on small screens
PWA header shows gym name properly
Member QR page renders properly on mobile
Member can see membership status card on home page (30 días restantes)
Fullscreen QR modal works on mobile
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed get_current_admin to use impersonation token data)
seed_data_creation: Created test gyms with admin credentials during testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 5 features tested and working: 1) Super admin impersonation with proper gym scoping (fixed bug in get_current_admin), 2) Auto gym admin creation during gym creation, 3) GET /api/gyms returns gym_admin_email/name, 4) PWA responsive design works on mobile (375px). The impersonation stores original_admin and original_token in localStorage before swapping sessions. Exit impersonation restores originals.

bug_fix_details.issue: Impersonation token gym_id not being used in API endpoints
bug_fix_details.root_cause: get_current_admin() function was fetching admin from database using JWT 'sub' field but ignoring the 'gym_id' and 'role' fields from the impersonation token
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Added check for 'impersonating' flag in JWT payload. When true, override admin's role and gym_id with values from token
